source: Die Premierminister Indiens und Japans trafen sich in Tokio.
reference: India and Japan prime ministers meet in Tokyo
hypothesis: The Prime Minister of India and Japan met in Tokyo.

source: Indiens neuer Premierminister Narendra Modi trifft bei seinem ersten wichtigen Auslandsbesuch seit seinem Wahlsieg im Mai seinen japanischen Amtskollegen Shinzo Abe in Toko, um wirtschaftliche und sicherheitspolitische Beziehungen zu besprechen.
reference: India's new prime minister, Narendra Modi, is meeting his Japanese counterpart, Shinzo Abe, in Tokyo to discuss economic and security ties, on his first major foreign visit since winning May's election.
hypothesis: India's new Prime Minister Narendra Modi meets on his first important visit abroad since his election victory in the month of May his Japanese counterpart Shinzo Abe in Toko, to discuss economic and security relations.

source: Herr Modi befindet sich auf einer fünftägigen Reise nach Japan, um die wirtschaftlichen Beziehungen mit der drittgrößten Wirtschaftsnation der Welt zu festigen.
reference: Mr Modi is on a five-day trip to Japan to strengthen economic ties with the third largest economy in the world.
hypothesis: Mr Modi is on a five-day trip to Japan, to discuss economic relations with the third largest economic nation in the world.

source: Pläne für eine stärkere kerntechnische Zusammenarbeit stehen ganz oben auf der Tagesordnung.
reference: High on the agenda are plans for greater nuclear co-operation.
hypothesis: Plans for a stronger nuclear cooperation are at the top of the agenda.

source: Berichten zufolge hofft Indien darüber hinaus auf einen Vertrag zur Verteidigungszusammenarbeit zwischen den beiden Nationen.
reference: India is also reportedly hoping for a deal on defence collaboration between the two nations.
hypothesis: India has reportedly also hopes for a treaty to provide defence cooperation between the two nations.

source: Polizei von Karratha verhaftet 20-Jährigen nach schneller Motorradjagd
reference: Karratha police arrest 20-year-old after high speed motorcycle chase
hypothesis: Police of Karratha arrested 20-year-old s after fast motorcycle hunting

source: Ein Motorrad wurde beschlagnahmt, nachdem der Fahrer es mit 125 km/h in einer 70 km/h-Zone und durch Buschland gefahren hatte, um der Polizei in Bilbara zu entkommen.
reference: A motorcycle has been seized after it was ridden at 125km/h in a 70km/h zone and through bushland to escape police in the Pilbara.
hypothesis: A motorcycle was confiscated to the driver at 125 km/h in a 70 km/h zone. He drove it through bushland to escape the police in Bilbara.

source: Verkehrspolizisten in Karratha versuchten heute morgen, ein blaues Motorrad zu stoppen, nachdem sie es dabei beobachtet hatten, wie es mit 125 km/h eine Tankstelle auf der Bathdate Road verließ.
reference: Traffic police on patrol in Karratha this morning tried to pull over a blue motorcycle when they spotted it reaching 125km/h as it pulled out of a service station on Bathgate Road.
hypothesis: Traffic police in Karratha tried today to stop a blue motorcycle after they had observed it. At 125 km/h, a gas station on the Bathdate Road was left.

source: Die Polizei berichtet, dass der Fahrer die Haltesignale dann ignorierte und weiter auf der Burgess Road fuhr, bevor er in das Buschland abbog, wo die Beamten es aus den Augen verloren.
reference: Police say the rider then failed to stop and continued on to Burgess Road before turning into bushland, causing the officers to lose sight of it.
hypothesis: The police report that the driver is the stop signal then ignored and continues to drive on Burgess Road before he is booed into the bushland where the officers are losing sight of it.

source: Das Motorrad sowie eine Person, die der Beschreibung des Fahrers entsprach wurden später bei einem Haus im Walcott Way in Bulgarra gesehen.
reference: The motorcycle and a person matching the description of the rider was then spotted at a house on Walcott Way in Bulgarra.
hypothesis: The motorcycle and the person who is the description of the driver were later seen at a house in the Walcott Way in Bulgarra.

source: Die Polizei von Karratha beschuldigt einen 20-jährigen Mann der Nichtbeachtung eines Haltesignals sowie rücksichtslosen Fahrens.
reference: Karratha Police have charged a 20-year-old man with failing to stop and reckless driving.
hypothesis: The police of Karratha accused a 20-year-old man of not respecting a stop signal and ruthless driving.

source: Er soll am 23. September vor dem Amtsgericht in Karratha erscheinen.
reference: He is due to appear in Karratha Magistrates Court on September 23.
hypothesis: He is due to be released to the Karratha District Court on September 23rd.
